form.label: Asset Configuration
form.description: Describe your assets (name, type, manufacturer, timezone, …). Stored in the KV Store per location (RBAC), and used to enrich every event.

html.p: Add metadata to a host once — name, type, manufacturer, timezone, owner, description — and Splunk attaches it to every event from that host (this is the same idea as Enterprise Security's Asset & Identity framework, done with OOTB lookups). Inventory is stored in the KV Store, one collection per location, so access follows the same RBAC wall as the indexes.

ul.li: To add or edit: fill the fields above (use the existing Host to edit a row — it upserts by host), pick the Site, and click Submit.
You can only write to a site your role owns; the seed comes from the committed assets_seed.csv and is reloaded each session.

panel.title: Viewing as (your role decides which sites you see/edit)

search.query: | rest /services/authentication/current-context splunk_server=local | eval r=mvjoin(roles," ") | eval g=if(match(r,"role_global") OR match(r,"admin"),1,0) | eval see_loc1=g, see_london=if(g==1 OR match(r,"role_london"),1,0), see_berlin=if(g==1 OR match(r,"role_berlin"),1,0) | eval "Visible sites"=mvjoin(mvappend(if(see_loc1==1,"loc1",null()),if(see_london==1,"london",null()),if(see_berlin==1,"berlin",null()))," , ") | rename username as User, r as Roles | table User Roles "Visible sites" see_loc1 see_london see_berlin

| makeresults | eval _key="$host$", site="$site$", host="$host$", ip="$ip$", asset_name="$asset_name$", hostname="$hostname$", asset_type="$asset_type$", manufacturer="$manufacturer$", timezone="$timezone$", description="$description$", owner="$owner$" | fields - _time | outputlookup dcloud_assets_$site$_lk append=true | eval Result="Saved ".host." to ".site." inventory" | table Result host site ip asset_name asset_type manufacturer timezone owner description
| inputlookup dcloud_assets_loc1_lk | table asset_name host hostname ip asset_type manufacturer timezone owner description | sort asset_name
| inputlookup dcloud_assets_london_lk | table asset_name host hostname ip asset_type manufacturer timezone owner description | sort asset_name
| inputlookup dcloud_assets_berlin_lk | table asset_name host hostname ip asset_type manufacturer timezone owner description | sort asset_name

panel.title: Enrichment in action — events by asset type (last 60 min)

search.query: index=* asset_type=* | stats count as Events, dc(host) as Hosts, values(asset_name) as Assets by asset_type manufacturer | rename asset_type as Type, manufacturer as Manufacturer | sort - Events

ul.li: Storage: KV Store collections dcloud_assets_loc1/london/berlin, seeded from assets_seed.csv.
RBAC: each collection + lookup is read/write-gated per role, so Ben sees only Berlin, Leo only London, Gary all — enforced, not just hidden.
Enrichment: automatic lookups on host add the asset fields to events across metrics, syslog, Cisco and Proxmox sourcetypes.
Try it: index=* asset_type=router | stats count by manufacturer, or add asset_name as a column on any search.
